email_source_note: Deep search per PIPELINE.md Fase 1 punto 7: (1) Instagram web_profile_info API for @etherealeyelashesfl (x-ig-app-id header) returned business_email: null, business_phone_number: null (is_business_account: false, is_professional_account: true); (2) bio external_url is https://linktr.ee/etherealeyelashesfl, opened directly: it lists 5 links (Booksy booking widget, Instagram, TikTok, a Google model-casting form, and a 'Website' link to https://etherealeyelashesfl.merlin-site.com/), no email/phone shown on the linktree page itself; (3) followed the 'Website' link and fetched its raw HTML: it contains a live contact section with 'mailto:etherealeyelashesfl@gmail.com' and 'tel:+16313535530', plus the same 932 NE 20th Ave address; (4) Booksy's public JSON-LD and its internal __NUXT_DATA__ payload were both checked for an email field: none present (only Booksy's own generic support links); (5) no Facebook page found in any of the above sources. own_site_check.domains_tried: etherealeyelashes.com (does not resolve, DNS failure); etherealeyelashesfl.com (does not resolve, DNS failure). Confirmed via curl: both return connection failures, no HTTP response.
own_site_check.merlin_site_finding: The Instagram bio's linktree links to https://etherealeyelashesfl.merlin-site.com/, a functional page with hero, about (Olga bio), services summary, gallery, testimonials section and a contact form, plus the real phone and email used on this build. This is a subdomain of 'merlin-site.com', a third-party website-builder platform (confirmed: merlin-site.com is the platform's own root domain, distinct from any domain the business owns; the business only has the 'etherealeyelashesfl' subdomain, with Merlin's own branding/CDN, merlin-cloudinary.b-cdn.net, serving its images). Per PIPELINE.md's explicit rule that platform subdomains (the same category as square.site or glossgenius.com) do NOT count as an own website, this is treated as has_own_site: false. IMPORTANT: there exist unrelated, same-named 'Ethereal Eyelashes' businesses in other cities (e.g. Beverly Hills / LA) with their own separate domains; those were not used anywhere in this research, per the task brief's explicit warning.
own_site_check.conclusion: NO independently owned apex domain. has_own_site: false. Outreach angle: 'I built you a sample website' / 'les construi un website de muestra'.

booking.note: The widget_url is the exact 'Book here' link published in the business's own linktree bio; the business_page_url is Booksy's public listing page for the same business, used for the 'read reviews' link. Booksy is a booking platform subdomain and does not count as an own website.

owner.source: Instagram bio and full_name field both credit 'Olga' as the artist/educator behind the account. Booksy staffer field for the business ('Olga', staffer id resolved from the Booksy Nuxt payload) confirms the same. The business's own Merlin-site About section (etherealeyelashesfl.merlin-site.com) names her explicitly: 'Master Lash Artist, Educator, Reiki & Energy Practitioner' with 'seven years of experience'. Multiple verified Booksy reviews address her by name (Megan: 'I have followed Olga to each of her locations for the past 5 years'; Zodi: 'She has been my lash slayer since 2020'), confirming she is a solo, well-established artist who has moved studio locations before opening this one.

services.source: Full 26-item service menu with exact names, prices and durations resolved from Booksy's live public JSON-LD (schema.org makesOffer, 26 offers) on the business page, fetched 2026-07-19. services.deposit_note: A $50 non-refundable deposit is required to book all full sets, per Booksy's business description text.
services.policies_verbatim_excerpt: Please arrive barefaced with no makeup on, lashes freshly cleansed with lash shampoo... Avoid caffeine before your service, bring headphones, relax, and enjoy a lash nap! reviews.name: Megan
reviews.quote: I have followed Olga to each of her locations for the past 5 years. There is absolutely no comparison to the quality of her work. There is no distance or length of drive that would convince me to let someone else touch these lashes. I am in love with her newest space, curated so intentionally in every way by her soul and spirit.

reviews.name: Tara
reviews.quote: I've been getting my lashes done since 2006 when lash extensions were just coming on the scene. Olga is by far one of the best if not the best lash artist I have ever had my lashes done by and if I could rate her a six star here would!

reviews.name: Zodi
reviews.quote: Olga never fails at making me feel beautiful! She is a true lash artist! She has been my lash slayer since 2020 and I can't imaging ever having anyone else! Thank you Olga for always exceeding my expectations! Congratulations on your new studio absolutely relaxing and chic!!

reviews.name: Nicole M.
reviews.quote: Literally the best there is! Olga is a perfectionist in every way and it shows in her work! Blown away each and every time i leave. Studio is super clean and serene too for an extra added bonus

reviews.name: Melisa S.
reviews.quote: Olga is super sweet and so talented! I was so nervous never having done this service before but I'm coming back forever because I love my eyelashes!

reviews.name: Iva B.
reviews.quote: Olga was super considerate and sweet. she took off a set I had done by another tech I had trouble with and talked to me and informed me a lot about lashes, I would definitely return for future services from her :)
reviews.source: Booksy, verified review (not used on site, kept as backup)

reviews.name: Rejina
reviews.quote: I've been going to Olga for years and always leave with full, beautiful lashes!

language_source: All 12 most recent Instagram captions are in English (e.g. 'Ghost lashes', 'Soft brown wispy set, but make it fight-proof', 'What if your morning routine was just... easier?'). All 26 Booksy service names and all 7 fetched Booksy reviews are in English. The IG bio's only Spanish is the trust line 'Se habla espanol', reflected on-site as a bilingual trust badge, matching the precedent used for lashbloom (same niche, same booking platform, same primary language).
brand_vibe: Warm, gold-and-ivory bohemian studio with a mystic/eclectic touch: a gold cursive 'Ethereal Eyelashes' wall sign, an eclectic gallery wall of colorful art prints (sun/moon/tarot-card motifs, cherries, snakes), a navy-lacquer console table with gold hardware, crystals, plants and soft natural light. Chose the LIGHT template (Amani exemplar) as base, with a custom warm gold/ivory palette derived from the real studio and its own gold signage (not one of the 5 pre-set DESIGN.md palettes): bg #faf6f0, ink espresso #362a1f, accent-deep warm gold #b3874f, accent-mid bronze taupe #a3855f, accent-soft gold-cream #f1e2c9. Dark CTA/footer bands keep the exemplar's warm espresso-brown gradient, consistent with the studio's warm-toned interior.
